---
import { getCollection, render } from 'astro:content'
import DocsLayout from '../layouts/DocsLayout.astro'
import GuideContent from '../components/GuideContent.astro'
import GuideHeader from '../components/GuideHeader.astro'
import GuidePagination from '../components/GuidePagination.astro'
import GuideScripts from '../components/GuideScripts.astro'
import { allMdxGuideMetadata } from '../libs/mdx-guides'
import { documentationPaths } from '../libs/content'

export async function getStaticPaths() {
  return documentationPaths((await getCollection('docs')).filter(document => !document.id.startsWith('components/')), await getCollection('guides'))
}

const { document, guide, index } = Astro.props
const Content = document ? (await render(document)).Content : null
const metadata = document?.data ?? guide
const authoredGuide = document && allMdxGuideMetadata().find(entry => entry.slug === document.id)
---
<DocsLayout title={metadata.title} description={metadata.description}>
  {Content ? <>
    {authoredGuide && <GuideHeader guide={authoredGuide} />}
    <Content />
    {authoredGuide && <GuideScripts slug={authoredGuide.slug} />}
    {authoredGuide && <GuidePagination slug={authoredGuide.slug} />}
  </> : <GuideContent guide={guide} index={index} />}
</DocsLayout>
